product.name: Monoprice Alpha In-Ceiling Speakers 8in Carbon Fiber 2-way (pair)
product.description: This carbon fiber in-ceiling speaker is the perfect combination of performance and style. The use of carbon fiber for the woofer means that the speaker can hit harder, go lower, and handle more power with significantly less distortion than conventional drivers. The silk dome tweeter produces clean, crisp, and clear highs and mids. You can fine tune the blend of sound using the built-in high frequency attenuator in case the sound is too bright. The metal grille can be painted to match your ceiling and attaches easily using magnets.Louder with Less Power | Higher Power Handling with Less DistortionControl High Frequencies | Easy to Install | Use up to 10AWG Cable8-inch Carbon Fiber 2-way In-Ceiling Speaker with Magnetic GrilleSound QualityStyleSimplicitySound Quality: Life is too short for speakers that don't sound great! Our engineers and audio experts have spent countless hours listening to and comparing various speakers until we were satisfied we had found models that fit our demanding standards.Style: While Monoprice believes in function over form, there is nothing wrong with having speakers that look good, too. This in-ceiling speaker helps reduce clutter by getting your speakers off the floor or bookshelves, and the magnetic metal grille can be painted to match your ceiling, so it virtually disappears from view.Simplicity: Installation is as easy as it can get. Use the included cutout template to mark your ceiling, make the cut, then using only a screwdriver, secure the speaker to the ceiling with the easy install mounting tabs.Carbon fiber gives you higher sensitivity, deeper bass, and higher power handling.Carbon fiber woofers are lighter and stiffer than conventional materials used in speaker manufacturing.
